extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: Large-scale publicly available satellite image time series dataset with semantic and panoptic annotations for agricultural parcel segmentation.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot; Loic Landrieu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of Sentinel-2 multi-spectral image sequences collected over four regions of France, with acquisitions automatically filtered for extensive cloud cover, and annotations sourced from the French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Acquisition irregularity results from automatic filtering of images with extensive cloud cover; close to 28% of images still have at least partial cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 multi-spectral satellite image time series with 10 non-atmospheric spectral bands, plus parcel annotations from the French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Satellite bands were atmospherically corrected and re-sampled to 10 meters per pixel; the dataset was split into 5 folds with a 1 km buffer between images to avoid cross-fold contamination.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Acquisitions with extensive cloud cover were automatically filtered by THEIA; Sentinel-2 bands were atmospherically corrected and resampled to 10 m spatial resolution.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel was assigned a semantic crop label from 18 crop types plus background, and each non-background pixel received a unique parcel instance label; annotations were taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Annotation quality is reported via French Payment Agency estimates: crop annotation accuracy over 98% from in situ control and relative surface error under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 semantic label and 1 instance label per pixel
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper states that the implementation and PASTIS dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/VSainteuf/utae-paps and https://github.com/VSainteuf/pastis-benchmark. It also notes a metric correction: values for the panoptic segmentation experiment differ from the ICCV 2021 proceedings because of a bug in the computation of the Recognition Quality metric in the original implementation; all models in Table 2 were re-evaluated with the corrected implementation, and readers are referred to github.com/VSainteuf/utae-paps/issues/11 for details.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset supports agricultural parcel monitoring with major economic and environmental implications, including fair allocation of subsidies and crop rotation compliance.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly class-imbalanced, with over 50x ratio between the most and least common classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Irregular acquisition times due to cloud filtering, partial cloud cover in about 28% of images, and strong class imbalance.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating semantic and panoptic segmentation models on satellite image time series; cross-validation benchmarking.

name.evidence: Lastly, we present Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series (PASTIS), the first open-access dataset for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on SITS
